event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approx.5.7 nm northwest from Pulau Cula, Indonesia, eastbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme Indonesia

sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2024
sources.text: While underway, two to three perpetrators in a boat attempted to board the ship from the starboard quarter. Upon raising the alarm and switching on the deck lights, the perpetrator’s boat moved off southward. The master reported the incident to the Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). Safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore
